description.value: Waffle House Diner is a retro-style breakfast and brunch spot in Surrey, BC, that recently relocated from New Westminster and brought with it an updated menu and a modern twist on the classic diner atmosphere. The kitchen leans into elevated comfort food — think Chicken and Waffles with chili-infused maple syrup, Turkish Eggs on garlic yogurt, and a rotating lineup of creative waffle and French toast builds. Pickup and delivery are both available, making it a practical stop for cyclists wanting a substantial meal without a long sit-down commitment.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating breakfast and brunch diner that recently relocated from New Westminster to Surrey, with an active menu, online ordering, and delivery partnerships (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Skip the Dishes). The phone number on the contact page (604-496-1117) matches OSM exactly. The cart page contains obvious leftover WordPress theme placeholder text (fake hours, 'edgesdishup@domain.com', dummy phone) that should be disregarded as template boilerplate. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: The /cart/ page contains leftover WordPress theme placeholder content including fake contact info ('edgesdishup@domain.com', '11 567 406 798') and placeholder hours that do not match the business — this is template boilerplate and should be disregarded.
Every page also contains a Lorem Ipsum-style Latin passage ('Alienum phaedrum torquatos nec eu...') as residual theme filler — the website is functional but not fully cleaned up from its template.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with an active website, online ordering, and delivery integrations. A solid calorie-stop for touring cyclists.
